name: decomposition-reframe-reconciliation
body: The decomposition goal is stated by `requirements.requirement.decomposed-source-modules`. `global.constraint.decomposition-quality` is the repo-wide decomposition law, and `domain.value.module-size-signal` states the ~400-line figure as indicative. The law's scope is first-party source excluding vendored code (`src/cpplib/vendor/**`) and testdata (`testdata/**`): the root Rust crate (`src/*.rs` plus `build.rs`) and the eight frontend crates. The eight frontend code roots are `rust.structfrontend`, `rust.pyfrontend`, `rust.apg-rustfrontend`, `cpp.cpplib`, `java.(default)`, `go.apg/gofrontend`, `csharp.Apg.CsharpFrontend`, and `ts.apg-tsfrontend`. `cpp.cpplib` covers `src/cpplib/main.cpp` and its vendored tree-sitter headers alike, with `src/cpplib/vendor/**` excluded at the file level; `java.(default)` is the Java frontend's default-package module. `Cargo.toml`, `.cargo/config.toml`, `scripts/gate.sh`, and `rust-toolchain.toml` are graphed `File` nodes (`code_type = 'config'`), serving as task and `implemented-by` targets.
